与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:艾米的经历、感受与成长。
Little by little, things began to change. At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Best of all, lamps light the underground cavern.

What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. David always says that small steps matter more than big plans. On Monday evenings, Amy reviews the notes from class. The manor still has its original Jacobean fireplaces and staircases.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Amy is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. David advised Amy to try swimming as a new hobby. Best of all, fish live in water.

The city park has become an important part of daily life. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. People around Amy often share different ideas about the plant garden. His backpack is full of comic books.
The plant garden looked quieter than usual that evening. The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Amy has practiced volleyball for three years and won a prize last term.
